_comment: What OpenClear ships that no lock file names, for the SBOM (scripts/sbom.py) and the third-party inventory (scripts/third_party.py). components: files vendored under src/openclear/static/ (update the version and sha256 when replacing one; tests/test_compliance/test_sbom.py checks them). system: the packages the image's final stage installs with apt (the test checks the Dockerfile names these). sdk_packages: licenses of the .NET SDK's NuGet references, which have no lock to read them from. python_license_files: license texts for Python packages whose wheel leaves its license file out, fetched from the package's own source at that version.

components.name: Material Symbols (Outlined)
components.used_for: Every icon in the interface, combined into one sprite by scripts/fetch_material_icons.py (unversioned upstream; the version is the day they were fetched)

system.name: python:3.13-slim
system.license: PSF-2.0 (Python); Debian packages under their own licenses
